section_summary.extract_value: The provided text lists examples of exercise-related talk, such as participating in sports or going to the gym. Figure 1 presents four path diagrams (a, b, c, d) illustrating attitudes and orientations as mediators in the relationship between body-related talk (exercise talk, weight loss/diet talk) and body appreciation. The caption provides F-statistics and R-squared values for each model.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summarized from the provided text content and Figure 1 caption.

Asset Caption.extract_value: Figure 1. Attitudes and orientations as mediators in the relationship between body-related talk and body appreciation. (a) Attitudes as mediators for exercise talk and body appreciation, F(3, 138) = 53.66, p < .001, r2 = .54. (b) Orientations as mediators for exercise talk and body appreciation, F(3, 137) = 14.40, p < .001, r2 = .24. (c) Attitudes as mediators for weight-loss talk and body appreciation, F(3, 138) = 62.14, p < .001, r2 = .57. (d) Orientations as mediators for weight-loss talk and body appreciation, F(3, 137) = 22.23, p < .001, r2 = .33. Unstandardized path coefficients are presented. The coefficients in parentheses represent the direct relationship between body-related talk and body appreciation.
